name: God Loving All Of His Children
overview: Scripture reveals God's steadfast love and mercy toward all His children, inviting every person to call upon Him in truth and receive His grace. The Psalms emphasize God's readiness to forgive and His compassion, describing Him as gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in mercy toward all who seek Him. Isaiah and Jeremiah further affirm God's intimate knowledge and care for His people, showing that He calls, protects, and sanctifies each individual as part of His covenant and purpose for the nations.
